problem: Production full-mode POST /prove is a placeholder that always returns RUNLESS_PLAN_REQUIRED, forcing proof orchestration to happen outside the normal Runless API path and creating manual/serial final-mile handoffs.
root_cause: The repository already contains the proof-plan loader, exact candidate workspace, Step 2A authorization, fingerprinting, static executor, public probe, immutable receipt store, and final-gate publisher, but api.py never composes them into the production /prove endpoint.
patch: Add a bounded real proof coordinator that validates repository/head/main/workstream/live scope lease/registry truth, loads the candidate-owned Runless plan, fingerprints exact artifacts and dependencies, executes static and required public proof without GitHub Actions fallback, writes or reuses an immutable receipt, publishes runless-final-gate on the exact candidate, and exits at MERGE_AUTHORIZED. Wire full-mode /prove to that coordinator while preserving bootstrap fail-closed behavior.
